name: cfg-provider-context-window-both
about: maxContextTokens=40000 与 contextWindow=30000 同时给时以 maxContextTokens 为准（parseModelConfig.ts:283 只在 maxContextTokens 未给时读别名）。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: cwp/cw
model:
  providers:
    cwp:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        cw:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 40000
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
            contextWindow: 30000
telemetry:
  enabled: false
